work_plan.output: Frozen brief and list of variables/interpretations; compare with owner request.
Dated price and yield matrix for usable ingredients; apply crab450 at raw leaf, cheese+30% only at cream-cheese leaf; define new mixtures explicitly.
Limited matrix of product families by principal protein, alternate inner base, cooking/construction; two salmon and two tartar variants. No automatic menu of every mathematical combination.
Paper recipe alternatives: ordinary total inner100–110g, rice110g; hat total62–80g and separate smaller inner filling parameter. Explicit primary-protein share and exterior components.
Per-variant material cost and alternative prices/FC under current and lighter benefits; whole sets counted once; mixture sales scenarios evaluate wholeline33%, not a33% ceiling per SKU.
Candidate selection and future physical validation requirements: geometry, distribution, taste, delivered condition, portions and process effort. No kitchen trial initiated in this task.

economic_limits: Existing8-prototype/Q19 wholeline30.05/28.05 results do not automatically apply after new crab/cheese/rice/menu changes.
33% remains a whole-rollline scenario target, not a hard ceiling for each recipe.
Without selling price no unique FC; without future sales weights no demonstrated weighted new-line FC.
A food-cost calculation alone does not prove500000 monthly net profit; full budget/capacity/demand update follows selection of offer.
